title: Laurel Marquise Necklace
intro: Leaves of light around the neck. Clear marquise cut cubic zirconia, about 5 x 10mm each, are set on a slant in groups of three like leaves on a stem, each stone in its own four claw gold tone setting, and each cluster linked to the next.
tip: Wear it alone with an open neckline, or with small studs.
details: Stones: Marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5 x 10mm, in four claw settings
Pattern: Clusters of three stones set on a slant, linked one to the next
Width: Approximately 9mm
Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Soleil Petal Pendant
intro: A small sun rising at the throat. One round clear cubic zirconia of about 7mm sits up in gold claws, and seven slender polished gold tone petals fan out below it like rays, about 25mm across in all, on a fine snake chain.
tip: Let it sit alone on a plain neckline, so the petals catch the light.
details: Pendant: Approximately 25mm across, seven open polished petals fanned below the stone
Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in a claw setting
Chain: Fine snake chain with a lobster clasp and extender
Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Pearl Crescent Pendant
intro: A pearl held by a new moon. One round white shell pearl of about 10mm sits in a small gold tone cup, with a slim crescent of small clear cubic zirconia curving around one side of it, on a fine box chain with a sliding bead.
tip: Slide the bead to wear it high at the collarbone or lower on a V neck.
details: Pearl: Round white shell pearl, approximately 10mm
Pearl source: Shell pearl, provenance not stated by the supplier
Stones: Small round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 2mm, in a crescent
Chain: Fine box chain with an adjustable sliding bead
Metal: Gold tone

tip: Wear it with a deep V or an open collar, so the drop runs straight.

title: V-Bar Teardrop Necklace
intro: A polished V and one clear drop. A dense gold tone wheat chain about 3.5mm wide, its small bright cut links set in a tight chevron, turns into two smooth gold tone bars that meet in a V at the front, and a pear cut clear cubic zirconia of about 10 x 13mm hangs point up from the point of the V.
tip: Wear it alone with a white top or a deep neckline.
details: Chain: Dense wheat chain of small bright cut links set in a chevron, approximately 3.5mm wide
Front: Two polished bars, approximately 15mm each, meeting in a V
Drop: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10 x 13mm, hanging point up in a claw setting
Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier
note: Renamed from Herringbone Teardrop Necklace on 3 Nov: the owner said the chain on the listing was wrong. The chain in hand is a curb chain of faceted links, not a herringbone; sizes re-measured against the bars and fingers in the owner's photo. Supplier's line with the photo: 390x5 1,950 (Rs 390 a piece for 5). Second note on 3 Nov ('the chain of other necklace on listing is wrong, the second image'): the 3 Nov photos drew a round-wire open curb; at 6x the stock chain is a dense chain of rice-grain links leaning in a chevron, as on an ear of wheat, so all five photos were redrawn with it (edits.py CHAIN7) and the copy now says wheat chain. Live price Rs 1,399 (compare-at Rs 2,499) as set by the owner; the ship scripts send no price for this piece.
